turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a and an?
turns.tutor:
Let us look at two words. In "a hat", hat starts with a consonant sound. In "an owl", owl starts with a vowel sound.
So the rule is: use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound.
Right: I see an owl. Wrong: I see a owl.
Now you try. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
